symptom.name: Belt stops intermittently
symptom.description: The belt stops intermittently during operation.

failure_modes.name: Photo-eye sensor blocked by dust
failure_modes.description: The photo-eye sensor is blocked by dust on the lens or reflector.

failure_modes.name: Belt tension below specification
failure_modes.description: Belt tension is below the specified deflection range.

corrective_actions.name: Clean the photo-eye lens and reflector
corrective_actions.description: Clean the photo-eye optics and confirm the sensor LED is green.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Clean the photo-eye lens, remove dust from the reflector, and confirm that the sensor LED is green.

corrective_actions.name: Adjust the belt tensioner to 8 mm to 12 mm deflection
corrective_actions.description: Adjust the belt tensioner until deflection is within specification.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Adjust the belt tensioner until belt deflection is between 8 mm and 12 mm.
